messages.subject: resfn question
parts:
Last question (sorry for so many, but it is handy to archive
these):


> I have also looked more closely at the commands that I
cut/pasted from your example, and found the following:
>
> resfn = "Psychotria_DEC_M0_unconstrained_v1.Rdata"
>
> I cannot see a file with this name in the directories -
is it important that it be customized to the data set? I
went ahead and ran the analysis, and have a couple of trees
to look at now! Will using the file cited above invalidate
the results?
>



Answer:

"resfn" means "results filename". This is just a file that
stores the results of a particular ML search, so that (if
you set runslow=FALSE) you don't have to re-run the search
from scratch if you don't want to. .Rdata is just a special
R format.

This file got saved in whatever you set your working
directory to. (Check with "getwd()")

Cheers,
Nick
